prereg.primary_metric: SQuAD F1 per question, paired arm-vs-text (higher is better)
prereg.cost_metric: server usage.prompt_tokens per request (lower is better)
prereg.ci: 95% percentile bootstrap of mean paired F1 delta, resampling whole chunks, 10000 iters, seed 0
prereg.secondary: EM, exact two-sided McNemar; UNREADABLE rate; F1 by position quartile

decision.POSITIVE: ratio <= 0.5 AND F1-delta CI lower bound > -0.05
decision.NEGATIVE_COST: ratio > 0.5 (no worthwhile saving regardless of recall)
decision.OCC-1 overall: POSITIVE if ANY image arm is POSITIVE (that arm seeds OCC-3), else NEGATIVE
decision.VOID: text-arm F1 < 0.60 (reader/instrument broken), any transport error or malformed 200 body left unrepaired, server identity mismatch, suite fingerprint or Pillow drift between plan and run, pre-registration drift between plan and code, a prompt-cache hit, an incomplete run, or GPU residency not proven (>= 2 in-flight samples with VRAM >= 16 GiB above the pre-launch baseline AND a KFD context for the server)
